# Gutenberg benchmark fixtures

Full public-domain books (Project Gutenberg) converted to plain paginated
HTML. Used by measurement-benchmark comparisons and multicol parity testing;
they exercise realistic paragraph structure — dialogue, varied lengths,
punctuation-heavy prose — unlike lorem-ipsum fillers.

These files are for testing only and are NOT part of the published npm
package (package.json `files` excludes `specs/`).

Sources: https://www.gutenberg.org/ebooks/11 (Alice), /1342 (Pride and
Prejudice), /2701 (Moby Dick). All in the public domain.
